architectPage.career.1.narrative.en: From the bustling halls of the Canton Fair to the boardrooms of London, Dr. Zhu's career began with the raw mechanics of international trade. Over fifteen years, he mastered the art of cross-border supply chain management — negotiating deals worth hundreds of millions, managing procurement portfolios for leading UK firms, and orchestrating complex Sino-European joint ventures.
architectPage.career.1.narrative.cn: 从熙熙攘攘的广交会展馆到伦敦的董事会会议室，朱博士的职业生涯始于国际贸易的原始机制。在十五年的时间里，他精通跨境供应链管理的艺术——谈判价值数亿的交易，管理英国领先公司的采购组合，并策划复杂的中欧合资企业。

architectPage.career.4.narrative.en: Beyond the boardroom, Dr. Zhu has dedicated himself to building bridges between cultures and nurturing the next generation of cross-border professionals. journalPage.article1.c1.en: A Stroke to the Left, a Stroke to the Right

journalPage.article1.c2.en: Not a coincidence of structure, but a deliberate choice of direction — A stroke to the left, rooted in reality; a stroke to the right, reaching toward the horizon.
journalPage.article1.c2.cn: 不是结构的巧合，而是方向的刻意选择——一撇，扎根现实；一捺，伸向远方。

journalPage.article1.c3.en: Over the past year, we stood at a rare rupture in time. Technology advanced at breakneck speed, AI reshaped countless industries, and capital and order were reshuffled again and again. The world did not become simpler — only more complex, louder, and more demanding.
journalPage.article1.c3.cn: 过去一年，我们站在一个罕见的时间断层上。科技以惊人的速度发展，人工智能重塑了无数行业，资本和秩序一次又一次地重新洗牌。世界并没有变得更简单——只会变得更复杂、更喧嚣、要求更高。

journalPage.article1.c4.en: Some were pushed forward by the era's momentum; others quietly grew weary in the rush. Yet the more turbulent the times, the more we need to awaken the soul: Do not become mere cogs in a system — Remember, before anything else, you are a person.
journalPage.article1.c4.cn: 一些人被时代的势头推着向前；另一些人则在匆忙中悄然疲惫。然而，时代越是动荡，我们越需要唤醒灵魂：不要仅仅成为系统中的齿轮——记住，在成为任何其他东西之前，你首先是一个人。

journalPage.article1.c6.en: In 2025, I witnessed countless people pressing forward — professionals working late beneath office lights, entrepreneurs redrawing the future through uncertainty, and the backbone generation building dreams while carrying family, duty, and self. Often unseen, you quietly uphold the foundations of the world.
journalPage.article1.c6.cn: 在2025年，我见证了无数人奋力前行——在办公室灯光下加班的专业人士，在不确定性中重绘未来的企业家，以及在背负家庭、责任和自我的同时筑梦的中坚一代。你们常常不为人知，却默默地支撑着世界的根基。

journalPage.article1.c7.en: A person is not made by labels. A person shines through choices.
journalPage.article1.c7.cn: 人不是由标签定义的。人因选择而闪耀。

journalPage.article1.c8.en: Choosing long-termism over short-term temptation, choosing rationality and expertise amid the noise, choosing to perfect the mundane even when misunderstood. These choices may not be dazzling, but they decide how far one can go.
journalPage.article1.c8.cn: 在短期诱惑面前选择长期主义，在喧嚣中选择理性和专业，在被误解时仍选择完善平凡。这些选择可能并不耀眼，但它们决定了一个人能走多远。

journalPage.article1.c10.en: As a legal professional, a finance practitioner, and a long-time observer at the crossroads of East and West, I firmly believe: What is truly scarce is not clever technique, but steadfast judgment of values; What truly endures is not fleeting luck, but verifiable competence and character.
journalPage.article1.c10.cn: 作为一名法律专业人士、金融从业者，以及长期在东西方十字路口的观察者，我坚信：真正稀缺的不是聪明的技巧，而是对价值观的坚定判断；真正长存的不是短暂的运气，而是可验证的能力和品格。

journalPage.article1.c11.en: The world changes, but its core logic remains: Trust is built over time; Respect is earned through kept promises; Real influence never comes from clamor.
journalPage.article1.c11.cn: 世界在变，但其核心逻辑不变：信任是随着时间建立的；尊重是通过信守承诺赢得的；真正的影响力从来不是来自喧哗。

journalPage.article1.c12.en: A Blessing for the New Year

journalPage.article1.c13.en: May you stay clear-eyed in a fast-paced world; Keep refining yourself amid uncertainty; Hold on to warmth and boundaries under pressure; And remember your original purpose as you climb.
journalPage.article1.c13.cn: 愿你在快节奏的世界中保持清醒；在不确定性中不断完善自己；在压力下坚持温暖和底线；在攀登时记住你的初心。

journalPage.article1.c14.en: No need to rush for validation. Let time work with you. Do the work — one solid step at a time. One person's strength may be limited, but when countless earnest, sincere, and professional people stand together, our era will be lifted toward steadiness.
journalPage.article1.c14.cn: 不需要急于求成。让时间与你合作。踏实工作——一步一个脚印。一个人的力量可能是有限的，但当无数认真、真诚、专业的人站在一起时，我们的时代将被推向稳健。

journalPage.article1.c15.en: What makes a person human is not speed, but direction. As the year begins, may you and I take up the brush, drawing our own strokes — steady, powerful, enduring.
journalPage.article1.c15.cn: 使人成为人的不是速度，而是方向。在新的一年开始之际，愿你我拿起画笔，画出属于我们自己的一撇一捺——稳健、有力、持久。

journalPage.article2.c1.en: Dr. Ian Zhu is a cross-border dispute resolution expert, now appointed as Head of China Desk Consultant at both Grant Thornton UK — one of the world's largest insolvency practices under the English legal system — and Gateley Plc, a 200-year-old law firm listed on the London Stock Exchange.
journalPage.article2.c1.cn: 朱博士是跨境争议解决专家，现被任命为致同英国（英国法律体系下全球最大的破产业务机构之一）和盖特利律师事务所（一家在伦敦证券交易所上市的拥有200年历史的律师事务所）的中国业务主管顾问。

journalPage.article2.c2.en: He works closely with specialist partners at both institutions to provide comprehensive solutions for Chinese enterprises going global, and for Chinese lawyers handling complex cases requiring English law-based risk control and cross-border asset preservation.
journalPage.article2.c2.cn: 他与两家机构的专业合伙人密切合作，为走向全球的中国企业，以及处理需要基于英国法律进行风险控制和跨境资产保全的复杂案件的中国律师提供全面的解决方案。

journalPage.article2.c4.en: UK legal services export nearly £10 billion annually worldwide. English law, UK arbitration and the common law judicial system have become the global standard for cross-border transactions, financial arrangements, asset structures, and dispute resolution.
journalPage.article2.c4.cn: 英国法律服务每年向全球出口近100英镑。英国法律、英国仲裁和普通法司法体系已成为跨境交易、金融安排、资产结构和争议解决的全球标准。

journalPage.article2.c5.en: In regions where Chinese enterprises are widely deployed — such as the Cayman Islands, BVI, Hong Kong, Singapore, Middle East common law zones (DIFC/ADGM), Saudi Arabia, Southeast Asia, Central Asia, and even Latin America and Africa — the vast majority of contracts, financing documents, and arbitration clauses adopt the English legal system.
journalPage.article2.c5.cn: 在中国企业广泛布局的地区——如开曼群岛、英属维尔京群岛、香港、新加坡、中东普通法区（DIFC/ADGM）、沙特阿拉伯、东南亚、中亚，甚至拉丁美洲和非洲——绝大多数合同、融资文件和仲裁条款都采用英国法律体系。

journalPage.article2.c7.en: For a long time, Chinese enterprises have generally lacked systematic support in compliance structure design, asset preservation, and cross-border dispute handling under English law, making them vulnerable to risks overseas.
journalPage.article2.c7.cn: 长期以来，中国企业在英国法律下的合规结构设计、资产保全和跨境争议处理方面普遍缺乏系统支持，这使得他们在海外容易面临风险。

Its core value lies in court-granted compulsory investigation powers, cross-border asset freezing and recovery rights, and civil and criminal liability for non-cooperative directors.
journalPage.article2.c15.cn: 英国破产从业者（IP）制度被广泛认为是世界上最强大的资产保护和债务重组框架之一。其核心价值在于法院授予的强制调查权、跨境资产冻结和追回权，以及不合作董事的民事和刑事责任。

journalPage.article3.c1.en: In May 2025, the Sino-European Entrepreneurs Summit was held at IESE Business School in Spain. Coinciding with the 50th anniversary of China-EU diplomatic relations, the summit focused on 'Global Cooperation in Transformation,' bringing together heavyweight figures from Chinese and European political and business circles.
journalPage.article3.c1.cn: 2025年5月，中欧企业家峰会在西班牙IESE商学院举行。恰逢中欧建交50周年，峰会聚焦“转型中的全球合作”，汇聚了中欧政商界重量级人物。

journalPage.article3.c2.en: The summit was co-organized by the China-Foreign Entrepreneurs Association and IESE Business School, with support from the Chinese Embassy in Spain and multiple institutions. Spain's Minister of Industry and Tourism noted in his opening speech that China and Europe, as 'the world's two great powers, two great civilizations, and two great markets,' share broad common interests in multilateralism and green development.
journalPage.article3.c2.cn: 本次峰会由中外企业家联合会和IESE商学院共同主办，并得到了中国驻西班牙大使馆及多家机构的支持。西班牙工业和旅游大臣在开幕致辞中指出，中欧作为“世界上两个大国、两大文明、两大市场”，在多边主义和绿色发展方面有着广泛的共同利益。

journalPage.article3.c4.en: In 1975, China's share of global GDP was merely 1.6%, with the economy of the then-EEC-9 nations roughly 18 times that of China. By 2025, the world had been transformed beyond recognition: China's GDP had reached 120% of the EEC-9 economies, and bilateral trade exceeded $600 billion annually.
journalPage.article3.c4.cn: 1975年，中国占全球GDP的比重仅为1.6%，当时欧共体九国的经济规模大约是中国的18倍。到2025年，世界已经发生了翻天覆地的变化：中国的GDP已经达到了欧共体九国经济体的120%，双边贸易额每年超过6000亿美元。

journalPage.article3.c5.en: This signifies that China and the EU have evolved from a relationship of 'volume disparity' to one of 'reciprocal parity,' from 'distant strangers' to 'deeply interdependent.' This is not merely a numbers game — it means that a deep understanding of each other's systems, regulations, and strategies has become a new gateway for Chinese enterprises venturing abroad.
journalPage.article3.c5.cn: 这标志着中欧已经从“体量悬殊”的关系演变为“对等平起平坐”的关系，从“遥远的陌生人”变成了“深度相互依存”。这不仅仅是一个数字游戏——这意味着对彼此制度、法规和战略的深刻理解已成为中国企业出海的新门户。

journalPage.article3.c7.en: “The rational response should be a coordinated move from the rest of the world against that single country that has started the war.” — Miguel Sebastián, Spain's Minister of Industry and Tourism
journalPage.article3.c7.cn: “理性的回应应该是世界其他国家采取协调一致的行动，对抗那个发动战争的单一国家。”——米格尔·塞巴斯蒂安，西班牙工业和旅游大臣

journalPage.article3.c8.en: The current global landscape faces challenges from new Cold War thinking, geopolitical conflicts, supply chain fragmentation, data sovereignty disputes, and tariff wars. Today's trade barriers are more like policy frictions arising from multiple countries, reminiscent of the 'named tariff wars' of the 1930s.
journalPage.article3.c8.cn: 当前的全球格局面临着新冷战思维、地缘政治冲突、供应链碎片化、数据主权争端和关税战的挑战。今天的贸易壁垒更像是多国引发的政策摩擦，让人想起20世纪30年代的“点名关税战”。

journalPage.article3.c10.en: Coordinating supply chain strategic deployment (semiconductors, pharmaceuticals, key raw materials)
journalPage.article3.c10.cn: 协调供应链战略部署（半导体、制药、关键原材料）

journalPage.article3.c11.en: Rebuilding trust-based legal frameworks (digital compliance, ESG standards)
journalPage.article3.c11.cn: 重建基于信任的法律框架（数字合规、ESG标准）

journalPage.article3.c12.en: Establishing third-party market mechanisms jointly (in Africa, Latin America, and other regions)
journalPage.article3.c12.cn: 共同建立第三方市场机制（在非洲、拉丁美洲等地区）

journalPage.article3.c14.en: Over the past decade, Chinese investment in Europe has been shifting from traditional energy and real estate toward new energy, high-tech, and digital infrastructure. The summit identified key areas where China-EU cooperation should focus:
journalPage.article3.c14.cn: 过去十年来，中国对欧洲的投资一直从传统能源和房地产转向新能源、高科技和数字基础设施。峰会确定了中欧合作应重点关注的关键领域：

journalPage.article3.c19.en: New Energy Vehicles & Automotive Supply Chain
journalPage.article3.c19.cn: 新能源汽车与汽车供应链

journalPage.article3.c20.en: Third-Place Cooperation: China-EU + Africa, Latin America, ASEAN
journalPage.article3.c20.cn: 第三方合作：中欧+非洲、拉美、东盟

journalPage.article3.c21.cn: 专业服务与跨境法律支持

journalPage.article3.c23.en: China-EU cooperation under the 'Belt and Road' and 'Global Gateway' strategies is highly complementary, particularly in Africa and other third-party markets — in infrastructure, healthcare, education, and digital interconnection — with shared potential for advancing high standards, green development, and inclusive growth.
journalPage.article3.c23.cn: “一带一路”和“全球门户”战略下的中欧合作具有高度互补性，特别是在非洲和其他第三方市场——在基础设施、医疗保健、教育和数字互联互通方面——在推进高标准、绿色发展和包容性增长方面具有共同潜力。

journalPage.article3.c24.en: “What is truly scarce between China and Europe is not opportunity, but executable pathway design. Tou Ying is committed to providing professional, grounded solutions and execution support for Chinese enterprises in the UK and European markets.”
journalPage.article3.c24.cn: “中欧之间真正稀缺的不是机会，而是可执行的路径设计。投英致力于为中国企业在英国和欧洲市场提供专业、落地的解决方案和执行支持。”
